```{r}
# Input files
ref_fasta  <- "Data/07_Split_Align_Merge/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned.fasta"   # FASTA with desired order
target_fasta <- "Data/05_LongBranch_removal/3di_famsa3dialigned_trim35.fasta"    # FASTA to be reordered
output_fasta <- "Data/05_LongBranch_removal/3di_famsa3dialigned_trim35_reordered_con.fasta"

# Read FASTA files
ref_seqs <- readAAStringSet(ref_fasta)
target_seqs <- readAAStringSet(target_fasta)

# Extract sequence names in desired order
ref_order <- names(ref_seqs)

# Check which sequences are shared
common_seqs <- ref_order[ref_order %in% names(target_seqs)]

# Warn if sequences are missing
missing_in_target <- setdiff(ref_order, names(target_seqs))
if (length(missing_in_target) > 0) {
  warning("These sequences are missing in target FASTA:\n",
          paste(missing_in_target, collapse = ", "))
}

# Reorder target FASTA
target_reordered <- target_seqs[common_seqs]

# Write output
writeXStringSet(target_reordered, output_fasta)

cat("Reordered FASTA written to:", output_fasta, "\n")

```

## Renaminng Spo AG And AH sequences
```{r}
xlsfn = "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/SporulationMatchingGenus_SpoIIIAH.xlsx" ## excel file with accession Number and desirable name
xls = openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile=xlsfn, sheet=1, startRow=1, colNames=TRUE)
fasta_file <- seqinr::read.fasta (file = "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa_SpoIIIAH_RBM2_Unmatched.fasta") ## Fasta file to be renamed
newnames = as.array(xls$protein)
accession_number = as.array(xls$AccessionNumber)
print(accession_number)
names(fasta_file) <- sapply(names(fasta_file), function(name) {
  fasta_ids <- strsplit(name, split = "\\.")[[1]][1]
  matched_name <- NULL
   for (j in 1:length(newnames)){
    newnames_accession <- strsplit(accession_number[j], split = "\\.")[[1]][1]
    if (fasta_ids == newnames_accession) {
      matched_name <- newnames[j]
      break
   }
   }
  if (!is.null(matched_name)) {
    return(matched_name)
  } else {
    return(name)
  }
})
seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = fasta_file, names=names(fasta_file), file.out = "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa_SpoIIIAH_RBM2.fasta") 
```

## Concat RBM1, RBM2, RBM3
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Directory containing your FASTA files ===
input_dir <- "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa"

# === Find all FASTA files by suffix ===
rbm1_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM1\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)
rbm2_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM2\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)
rbm3_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM3\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)

# === Helper function to read and combine FASTAs ===
combine_fastas <- function(file_list) {
  all_seqs <- AAStringSet()
  for (f in file_list) {
    seqs <- readAAStringSet(f)
    all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, seqs)
  }
  return(all_seqs)
}

# === Combine and save ===
if (length(rbm1_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm1 <- combine_fastas(rbm1_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm1, file.path(input_dir, "aa_RBM1.fasta"))
}

if (length(rbm2_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm2 <- combine_fastas(rbm2_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm2, file.path(input_dir, "aa_RBM2.fasta"))
}

if (length(rbm3_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm3 <- combine_fastas(rbm3_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm3, file.path(input_dir, "aa_RBM3.fasta"))
}

```

```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input files (edit paths) ===
file1 <- "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
file2 <- "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"

# === Read sequences ===
seqs1 <- readAAStringSet(file1)
seqs2 <- readAAStringSet(file2)

# === Convert to named character vectors ===
seqs1_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs1), names(seqs1))
seqs2_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs2), names(seqs2))

# === Combine all sequence names ===
all_names <- unique(c(names(seqs1_vec), names(seqs2_vec)))

# === Determine max lengths for padding ===
maxlen1 <- max(nchar(seqs1_vec))
maxlen2 <- max(nchar(seqs2_vec))

# === Initialize result ===
combined_vec <- character(length(all_names))
names(combined_vec) <- all_names

# === Merge horizontally (with gap-fill if missing) ===
for (n in all_names) {
  seq1 <- if (n %in% names(seqs1_vec)) seqs1_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen1), collapse = "")
  seq2 <- if (n %in% names(seqs2_vec)) seqs2_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen2), collapse = "")
  
  combined_vec[[n]] <- paste0(seq1, seq2)
}

# === Convert back to AAStringSet ===
combined_set <- AAStringSet(combined_vec)

# === Write output ===
output_file <- "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
writeXStringSet(combined_set, output_file)



```

## Removing AH, AG and AF files from the final file trying a separate analysis
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input and output files ===
input_file <- "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned.fasta"    # replace with your fasta file path
output_file <- "Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed.fasta"

# === Read sequences ===
seqs <- readAAStringSet(input_file)

# === Filter sequences ===
# Keep sequences whose names do NOT end with the given patterns
keep_seqs <- seqs[!grepl("(SpoIIIAG|SpoIIIAF|SpoIIIAH)$", names(seqs))]

# === Save filtered sequences ===
writeXStringSet(keep_seqs, output_file)
```

```{bash}
trimal -in ./Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed.fasta -out ./Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed_trim35.fasta -gt 0.35 -colnumbering | tee ./Data/17_AF_removed_AHAG_Merged_noOutgroup/aa/aa_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed_trim35_cols.txt
```
